review_method: Human visual inspection of actual PNG pixels in eight supplied fresh-GLB renders and three independently rendered diagnostics. No postpaint. Numerical contact/geometry checks supplement the sampled views.

builder_views_reviewed.name: eye_level
builder_views_reviewed.finding: Roof rail/post corner black patches corrected; underside connections read coherently.

builder_views_reviewed.name: roof_drain_detail
builder_views_reviewed.finding: Gutter/endcap and verge have clean edge relationships; a thin fabricated seam remains rather than black coincident-face stripes.

builder_views_reviewed.name: front_threequarter
builder_views_reviewed.finding: Coherent shelter silhouette and material separation; rounded timber edges, seated feet and suspended bench read clearly.

builder_views_reviewed.name: rear_threequarter
builder_views_reviewed.finding: Rear folded screen reads continuous and opaque, with intentional bottom/upper clearance and attached downpipe.

builder_views_reviewed.name: front
builder_views_reviewed.finding: Balanced frame and three support positions; no center-seam contact patch remains.

builder_views_reviewed.name: bench_join_detail
builder_views_reviewed.finding: Bench slats, back uprights, arm and support hardware read joined.

builder_views_reviewed.name: ground_contact
builder_views_reviewed.finding: Collar, plate, washers/nuts form a coherent foot; numerical plate minimum is ground Z=0. Review floor is not asset geometry.

builder_views_reviewed.name: rear
builder_views_reviewed.finding: Screen coverage, central joint and four-foot stance remain coherent from straight rear.

independent_views_reviewed.finding: Three braced bearers and rear support assembly visible. Prior lower-mullion underside patch removed.
Near-overhead view clearly shows a through-hole into the hollow pipe, including the faceted pipe rim.
Endcap has a thin overlap seam; no former black verge stripe or large coplanar patch appears.

limitations: Finite offline views and Cycles lighting do not establish target-renderer appearance at all angles or distances.
Floor/lights/cameras used only for review; physical watertightness, water flow, load behavior and accessibility are outside scope.

presentation_derivatives.contact_sheet_visual_finding: Eight labeled source views read clearly; label descenders are visible and no cells appear cropped unexpectedly.
